Genevieve Goldcrest of Goldrock weds Godwin Wolfholt, heir of House Wolfholt. A minor house rises. "A lesser house? A useful alliance, then. Let the Goldcrests bend to Wolfholt's strength; a fine seed for the next generation."
Ravens fly between House Wolfholt and House Goldcrest. Constance Wolfholt and Cecily Goldcrest speak of friendship.
The royal tithe brings 17 gold to Kingsmere.
House Highfell founds the town of Eaglehaven.
Ysolde Thornvale of House Thornvale leaves Kingsmere unheard, and says so to anyone who will listen.
The year 303 AC begins.
Ysolde Thornvale of House Thornvale comes to court.
Men without banners raid Crowford. Everyone knows who paid them: House Ironreach. "Let the dogs of Wolfholt know the bite of Ironreach. Their pride will be broken in the blood of their soil."

Cecily Stormhold refuses Corwin Greyford's offer of his daughter's hand. The insult is remembered. "A Thornvale? They smell of damp earth and lesser ambitions. Osric deserves a match that speaks of true stone, not mere moss."
Ravens fly between House Wolfholt and House Goldcrest. Constance Wolfholt and Cecily Goldcrest speak of friendship.
Treachery! Maud Strand opens the gates of Windcross to House Thornvale.
The year 304 AC begins.
House Stormhold storms Moonhold, tearing it from House Sunspire.
House Sunspire founds the town of Crowbarrow.
Ysolde Thornvale of House Thornvale comes to court.
House Thornvale founds the town of Mooncrag.

Ysolde Ironreach refuses Cecily Stormhold's offer of his daughter's hand. The insult is remembered. "Marriage for coin and scraps? My blood demands better than a mere trinket for a lesser house. Let Stormhold keep their girl, or they'll learn the price of insolence."
Ravens fly between House Wolfholt and House Goldcrest. Constance Wolfholt and Cecily Goldcrest speak of friendship.
Men without banners raid Crowford. Everyone knows who paid them: House Ironreach. "Let the wolves taste the salt spray. They think their wolf-howl shields them, but my blade remembers every slight."
House Thornvale founds the town of King'smere.

The year 305 AC begins.

Ysolde Ironreach refuses Bryony Varn's offer of his daughter's hand. The insult is remembered. "A lesser house for my son? The scent of ambition hangs heavy around this offer, and I smell only dust where honor should bloom. Thornvale shall find their paltry silks gathered back to their own keep."
Ravens fly between House Wolfholt and House Goldcrest. Constance Wolfholt and Cecily Goldcrest speak of friendship.

Barracks rise in Moonbarrow. House Goldcrest is arming.

Men without banners raid Crowford. Everyone knows who paid them: House Ironreach. "Let the wolves learn the meaning of Ironreach's steel. Whispers are for cowards; a blade speaks louder than any lie."
Treachery! Osric Pell opens the gates of Crowhold to House Sunspire.
Windspire is razed to the ground by House Thornvale.

Ysolde Ironreach refuses Cecily Sunspire's offer of his daughter's hand. The insult is remembered. "Sunspire? A twig on the wind. My son deserves a shield-maiden, not some delicate bloom from a lesser weed."
Ravens fly between House Wolfholt and House Goldcrest. Constance Wolfholt and Cecily Goldcrest speak of friendship.
House Ironreach founds the town of Moonhold.

Men without banners raid Crowfell. Everyone knows who paid them: House Ironreach. "Let the wolf taste steel before she ever dares look at Saltkeep again. A whisper is for weaklings, I prefer the blood to speak for itself."
Moonhold is razed to the ground by The Crown.
